summary: Iteration 3 focused on the new Next Best Action (NBA) leads panel + Airtable-backed leads service. Backend: 11/11 new pytest cases green in /app/backend/tests/leads_nba_test.py — GET /api/leads/next-best-action returns a populated lead (name+next_action non-empty, opportunity_type or source present, id starts 'rec'), queue stats are all ints with eligible(21) < total(113) confirming the skeleton-lead gate; POST skip returns state='skipped' and next GET returns a different lead id; PATCH /api/leads/{id}/message persists and was restored to original value in finally; POST hold returns state='hold' and lead disappears from eligible queue (on_hold >=1); POST approve returns state='approved' with ISO approved_at timestamp and persisted['Approval status']=true / persisted['Outreach status']=true (Airtable writes confirmed); POST do_not_contact without confirm → 400, with confirm:true → 200 state='do_not_contact' with persisted_to field; unknown action → 400. Regression: /api/opportunities list and PATCH /api/opportunities/{id}/fields still pass. Frontend (Playwright, live URL): / renders nba-card, nba-recommended-action headline non-empty ('Research permit records and CRM to collect address, phone number, estimated valu…'), all 4 action buttons (nba-approve/hold/skip/dnc) present. Clicking nba-skip reloads a different lead ('Call Keith Deshautreaux…'). Clicking nba-dnc reveals nba-dnc-confirm. Sidebar navigation to /opportunities renders opportunity cards. Ctrl+K opens command palette with palette-input. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: leads_service.LeadsAirtableService keeps per-process sets (_skipped/_held/_approvals) — a single-worker assumption. If uvicorn ever runs multi-worker, skip/hold state will diverge across workers. Document or centralise (Redis / DB) before scaling.

leads_service.do_not_contact writes the literal string 'Do Not Contact' into a Status/Outreach status/Approval status field. If those fields are Airtable single-select without that option, pyairtable will raise and _safe_update swallows the exception silently → the endpoint still returns state='do_not_contact' with persisted_to=None. Consider surfacing the write failure to the client (e.g. include the underlying error in note) so operators know it was session-only.

GET /api/leads/next-best-action returns None-valued fields for every mapped Airtable column even when the lead has no data — response is heavy (35+ keys). Consider stripping None values or using a lean DTO for the NBA endpoint.

server.py leads_action approve/hold/skip/do_not_contact do not validate that lead_id exists before mutating — a stale/bad id will still return state='approved' with persisted=False. Add existence check via svc.get(lead_id) → 404 if missing.

server.py /api/config still reports backend='sample' while AIRTABLE_ENABLED=true because that flag applies to Opportunities. This is confusing — expose an explicit 'leads_backend' key so operators can see the leads table is live even when opps are still on sample.
